Class WorldMap

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.WorldMap
@Entity public class WorldMap extends Object
Represents a world map configuration with data sources and boundaries. Supports multiple maps (Earth, procedurally generated planets, etc.).

Each map defines:

  • Geographic boundaries (lat/lng corners)
  • Data sources (elevation, biome maps)
  • Planet size (for procedural generation)
  • H3 resolution level
